title: Doctors Give New Guidelines for Preventing Stroke
speaker: VOA Learning English

sentences.en: From VOA Learning English, this is the Health & Lifestyle report.
sentences.zh: 从VOA学习英语, 这是健康和生活方式报告。

sentences.en: New guidelines have been issued in the United States for preventing stroke – the nation’s 4 th biggest killer.
sentences.zh: 美国已经发布了预防中风的新指导方针 — — 国家第四大杀手。

sentences.en: The U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) says that in 2023, stroke was the fourth leading cause of death in the United States.
sentences.zh: 美国疾病控制和预防中心(CDC)指出,2023年,中风是美国第四大死亡原因。

sentences.en: An estimated half a million people suffer strokes in the U.S. each year.
sentences.zh: 据估计,美国每年有50万人中风。

sentences.en: But the CDC notes that up to 80 percent of strokes could be prevented with better nutrition and exercise, along with improved risk identification.
sentences.zh: 但疾病防治中心指出,如果改善营养和锻炼,同时改进风险识别,高达80%的中风是可以预防的。

sentences.en: What is a stroke? A stroke happens when blood flow to part of the brain is blocked or if a blood vessel in the brain breaks open, or bursts.
sentences.zh: 中风是什么?当血液流到部分大脑时会中风,或者脑中的血管裂开,或者爆发。

sentences.en: The event keeps oxygen from getting to the brain.
sentences.zh: 事件阻止了氧气进入大脑

sentences.en: This can result in the person having difficulty thinking, talking and walking.
sentences.zh: 这可能导致一个人难以思考、说话和走路。

sentences.en: In some cases, a stroke can even cause death.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下,中风甚至会导致死亡。

sentences.en: Stroke is a major health problem across the world.
sentences.zh: Stroke是全世界的一个主要健康问题。

sentences.en: On its website, the World Stroke Organization says the condition is a leading cause of death and disability worldwide.
sentences.zh: 世界笔记本组织在其网站上说,这一状况是造成全世界死亡和残疾的主要原因。

sentences.en: Over 100 million people worldwide have suffered a stroke.
sentences.zh: 全世界有1亿多人中风。

sentences.en: It is estimated that 25 percent of adults over 25 will have a stroke during their lifetime.
sentences.zh: 据估计,25岁以上的成人中有25%一生中将中风。

sentences.en: The new guidelines on stroke prevention came from the American Stroke Association.
sentences.zh: 关于中风预防的新准则来自美国斯特克协会。

sentences.en: They are the first to be issued in 10 years.
sentences.zh: 这是十年来首次印发的。

sentences.en: The advice includes suggestions for people and doctors and are based on improved information about who has strokes and why.
sentences.zh: 咨询内容包括向人和医生提供建议,并基于有关谁中风和为什么中风的更好的信息。

sentences.en: The guidelines also include new drugs that can help reduce risk.
sentences.zh: 准则还包括有助于减少风险的新药物。

sentences.en: Health researchers say the best way to reduce the risk of stroke is the same as reducing risks for many other conditions.
sentences.zh: 卫生研究人员说,减少中风风险的最佳方式与减少许多其他疾病的风险相同。

sentences.en: These include eating a healthy diet, moving the body often and not smoking.
sentences.zh: 其中包括吃健康的饮食,经常移动身体,不吸烟。

sentences.en: Here is what to know about stroke and the newly issued guidelines: Eating healthy can reduce stroke risk Experts say eating healthy can help control possible stroke risks.
sentences.zh: 以下是关于中风和新发布的指南:健康饮食可以降低中风风险。

sentences.en: The goal is to prevent or reduce high cholesterol, high blood sugar and obesity, the condition of being extremely overweight.
sentences.zh: 目标是预防或减少高胆固醇、高血糖和肥胖症,因为其体重过重。

sentences.en: The advice urges people to choose foods in the so-called Mediterranean diet.
sentences.zh: 这些建议敦促人们在所谓的地中海饮食中选择食物。

sentences.en: These include fruits, vegetables, whole grains and olive oil.
sentences.zh: 其中包括水果、蔬菜、整粒谷物和橄榄油。

sentences.en: Eating these foods can help keep cholesterol levels down.
sentences.zh: 食用这些食物可以帮助降低胆固醇水平。

sentences.en: Red meat should be limited, along with saturated fats .
sentences.zh: 红肉和饱和脂肪应该有限。

sentences.en: Additional protein can come from beans, nuts, poultry and seafood.
sentences.zh: 更多的蛋白质来自豆类、坚果、家禽和海鲜。

sentences.en: Highly processed foods and drinks with a lot of added sugar should also be avoided.
sentences.zh: 还应避免大量加糖的高加工食品和饮料。

sentences.en: Moving your body can help prevent strokes Getting up and walking around for at least 10 minutes a day can greatly reduce a person’s stroke risk, said Dr.
sentences.zh: 医生说,移动身体可以帮助防止中风,每天起身行走至少10分钟,可以大大降低一个人的中风风险。

sentences.en: Cheryl Bushnell. She is a neurologist at Wake Forest University School of Medicine in North Carolina.
sentences.zh: Cheryl Bushnell 她是北卡罗来纳州Wake森林大学医学院的神经科医生

sentences.en: Bushnell was part of the group that came up with the new guidelines.
sentences.zh: 布希内尔是制定新准则的团体的一部分。

sentences.en: She said regular exercise can help reduce blood pressure, a major risk factor for stroke.
sentences.zh: 她说,定期锻炼有助于降低血压,这是中风的一个主要风险因素。

sentences.en: However, health experts say more movement is better.
sentences.zh: 然而,卫生专家说,更多的行动是更好的。

sentences.en: The stroke association suggests at least 150 minutes of moderate aerobic or 75 minutes of vigorous exercise activity every week.
sentences.zh: 中风协会建议每周至少有150分钟有氧运动或75分钟强力锻炼。

sentences.en: Such exercise could include going to the gym, taking a walk or running.
sentences.zh: 这种活动可包括去健身房、散步或跑步。

sentences.en: People can also use exercise machines at home, dance or play a sport.
sentences.zh: 人们也可以在家里使用锻炼机、跳舞或玩运动。

sentences.en: New tools to reduce obesity, a risk factor for stroke The guidelines include a new group of drugs that have been proven to help people lose weight.
sentences.zh: 减少肥胖的新工具是中风的风险因素。 准则包括经证明有助于人们减肥的新型药物。

sentences.en: The drugs – designed for people with obesity or diabetes – had not been approved when past guidelines were issued.
sentences.zh: 这些药物是为肥胖或糖尿病患者设计的,但在发布以往的指导方针时没有得到批准。

sentences.en: But the advice now suggests doctors consider these drugs for patients at risk for stroke.
sentences.zh: 但是现在的建议是 医生认为这些药物是治疗有中风风险的病人的

sentences.en: These include versions sold under the names Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro, and Zepbound,.
sentences.zh: 其中包括以Ozempic、Wegovy、Mounjaro和Zepbound等名称出售的版本。

sentences.en: The new guidelines also help doctors identify people who might be at higher risk for stroke.
sentences.zh: 新的准则还有助于医生确定哪些人中风风险较高。

sentences.en: For the first time, the advice suggests doctors screen patients for other risk factors.
sentences.zh: 咨询意见首次建议医生对病人进行其他风险因素的检查。

sentences.en: They could include gender or non-medical factors such as economic issues or the availability of quality health care.
sentences.zh: 它们可包括性别或非医疗因素,如经济问题或能否获得优质保健。

sentences.en: The new guidelines also suggest that doctors screen for conditions that may increase a woman’s risk for stroke.
sentences.zh: 新准则还建议医生检查可能增加妇女中风风险的条件。

sentences.en: These could include high blood pressure during pregnancy or early menopause .
sentences.zh: 这可能包括妊娠期或更年期早期的高血压。

sentences.en: How do I know if I’m having a stroke and what do I do?
sentences.zh: 我怎么知道自己是否中风,

sentences.en: Three of the most common stroke signs include face weakness, arm weakness and difficulty speaking.
sentences.zh: 三种最常见的中风迹象包括面部弱点、手臂弱点和困难。

sentences.en: Also, time is important when a person suffers a stroke.
sentences.zh: 此外,当一个人中风时,时间也很重要。

sentences.en: Brain damage can happen quickly, but it can be limited if a stroke is treated quickly.
sentences.zh: 脑损伤可能很快发生,但如果中风得到迅速治疗,则会受到限制。

sentences.en: Stroke experts have created an acronym to help people remember: FAST -- F for face, A for arm, S for speech, and T for time.
sentences.zh: Stroke专家创建了一个缩略语,帮助人们记住:FAST -- -- F对面、A对臂、S对言语、T对时间。

sentences.en: If you think you or a loved one may be having a stroke, call the emergency response number in your area immediately.
sentences.zh: 如果你觉得自己或爱人中风了 请立刻拨打你所在地区的紧急反应电话

sentences.en: And that’s the Health & Lifestyle report.
sentences.zh: 这是《健康与生活方式报告》。

sentences.en: I’m Anna Matteo. And I’m Bryan Lynn. Kenya Hunter reported this story for the Associated Press.
sentences.zh: 我是Anna Matteo。我是Bryan Lynn。肯尼亚亨特为美联社报道了这个故事。
